Looking at the diff, the test creates a post with `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, title, contents)` then calls import again with new contents and only checks `post.cooked.should =~ /new contents/`. This is a legitimate test coverage gap - the update path in TopicEmbed.import (lines 28-35 in topic_embed.rb) uses PostRevisor to update existing posts, but the test doesn't verify this behavior properly. The finding is specific to the diff and identifies a real testing weakness, though it's not a bug in the implementation itself.
